load_config_from_file: load a Python or YAML config file into an OmegaConf DictConfig using LazyConfig.load
build_dataloader_from_config: build a PyTorch DataLoader from a lazy config with dataset and training parameters
build_model_from_config: build a PyTorch model from config and wrap in DDP for multi-GPU training
build_optimizer_from_config: build a PyTorch optimizer from config with weight decay settings per parameter
create_lazy_call_wrapper: create a LazyCall wrapper that returns a DictConfig describing a deferred callable invocation
